correctness.rationale: An exact Walsh-character computation establishes w_k>0 at all interior levels and parity-dependent activity of the top level. The strict rank-one secular equation gives exactly d or d-1 simple new roots, with a unique collision at top eigenvalue for even r. The binomial integral gives the r=2 formula. Generic CG degree follows from the SPD minimal polynomial. A 524-assertion independent finite checker corroborates, but does not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: A whole natural graph family is classified in dimension, shortcut Hamming distance and positive edge weight, exposing a parity-controlled spectral collision and an exact generic Krylov termination cost. It sharpens a motivating broad rank-one doubling bound and provides an explicit tunable graph-design example. The result is not a trivial reformulation of positivity nor a routine finite example and makes no claim about floating-point speed.
